title: O domine Jesu Christe (La Rue)
desc: Pierre de la Rue, O domine Jesu Christe. 4 voices (Discantus, Contra, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Rue2015); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
